candidate_windows.window_text: We experiment with nine open-sourced 7B parameter language models. All experiments were performed on an A6000 GPU. We used 8-bit quantization using the BitsAndBytes library (Dettmers et al., 2022) on all models. For generation tasks like MD3 intent detection and TyDiQA Extractive QA, we use greedy decoding. We will release all of our code publicly upon publication. We include all prompts here for MD3 (Table 8), TyDiQA (Table 9), Belebele (Table 10), and GlobalOpinionsQA (Table 11). For Global Opinions, we use the "default" prompt from the original paper (Durmus et al., 2023).
